editor_reconstruction_note: Over 6 frames the background greys down while a glowing 'SUN' disc with short rays (left on whiteboard) and the label 'UN-SUN-SPECTING EARTH' with down arrow over a small globe (right) fade in on the empty whiteboard; stick figure gains a grey shaded crescent on head.

White looping lobed field lines grow around SUN and a thin white beam line appears from SUN to the globe (globe gets a glow); label cross-fades from 'UN-SUN-SPECTING EARTH' to 'UNINHABITABLE EARTH' (overlapped double text at f98).
Small bracket marker with '1m' appears on the beam just left of the globe (white ink, tiny).
Stick figure redrawn: now wears black sunglasses and a ponytail-like hair shape, arm raised to the brow; paper no longer held. Whiteboard unchanged.

Hard cut at f349 to solid red title card: black silhouette of a dinosaur on a satellite upper-middle, 'xkcd's' small and large white 'what if?' with 'THE VIDEO SERIES' below. Tiles f349-f387 look identical; at f397 (last sample) cut to dark space scene: bright sun inside a grey ring with nozzle beaming a thin white beam to a small cratered globe at right and a tiny moon upper right. Exact onset of the second cut and any card animation UNRESOLVED.

Hard cut to near-black canvas: thick white blurred-edge beam from the left edge at mid height; white-ink stick figure right with arrow labels 'DNA' (head), 'FATTY ACIDS' (head right), 'BLOOD' and 'MITOSIS' (lower left), 'CELLULOSE' (lower right).

Beam extends across the full width and the stick figure is replaced by a burst of white dots, streaks and scattered letters (D N A F T S ... M I T O S I S, C E L L U L O S E) in upper and lower clusters at right.
Some of the scattered letters (top and bottom clusters) turn pink/red; rest unchanged. First red marks in this sequence.
White line-drawn fragments (small molecule/bond sketches and symbols such as 'e', 'W', 'Z' - unreadable at tile scale) appear in both particle clusters.
Hard cut to dark canvas: bright white sun disc with wide soft halo at left; small half-lit grey globe right; no labels.
Label '~1.5·10^22 J/day' appears below the globe at right (white hand-lettered). Sun halo also looks dimmer in this tile than in neighbours (UNRESOLVED whether a glow pulse).

Two texts appear at once: '~3.8·10^26 J/second' below the sun and a two-line note at top 'MAX SPECIFIED 'VISIBLE' LIGHT, WHICH ONLY MAKES UP ~50% OF THE SUN'S ENERGY OUTPUT, BUT A FACTOR OF 1/2 IS NOT GOING TO SAVE US HERE'.
Top note disappears; grey ring shell with two nozzles appears around the sun and a wide soft grey beam links it to the globe, with small spike marks at the globe.
Red strike-through scribble drawn over '~1.5·10^22 J/day' and red text '~2,000,000,000x' added below it.
Wide grey beam replaced by a thin bright white beam from the nozzles to the globe, with a glow at impact.
Small red bracket marker with '1m' appears on the beam near the globe.
Hard cut to close-up of Earth's limb: grey planet with black outline, white cloud shapes across the atmosphere band, lighter continents below; small moon upper right.
Thin white vertical beam appears from the top edge down to the atmosphere with a bright glow at the contact point.

Red glow spreads around the impact; clouds shrink to small specks; label 'MILLIONS OF DEGREES (FAHRENHEIT, CELSIUS, RANKINE, OR KELVIN - IT DOESN'T REALLY MATTER)' with curved arrow appears upper left.
A white half-dome of plasma with pink rim and label 'PLASMA' appears at the impact point, carving into the atmosphere band; clouds gone.
Larger jagged-edged white plasma region appears around the dome with red wavy arrows radiating outward; labels 'X-RAYS' and 'MORE PLASMA' appear.
Longer red wavy arrows extend left and right across the atmosphere with pink tinted regions; label 'IR' appears at left.

Labels and arrows removed; atmosphere becomes a large white-pink glowing band with spray of white debris at impact and black jagged crust fragments along the surface; moon still upper right, beam still vertical. Stepwise swap in one frame (no visible camera move).

Hard cut to full Earth (dark grey, black outline) right of centre on black; horizontal white beam from left edge ending in a glowing red crescent; white label 'RIP' with curved arrow above the impact.
Label 'SAFE?' with a curved arrow pointing at the far (right) side of Earth appears upper right.

Earth and labels re-positioned higher in frame; red 'NOT' added above 'SAFE' and the question mark is now a red mark. Whether the whole canvas shifted up UNRESOLVED (tiles at 68.4 and 69.7 show same layout).
Tiny white outlined glyphs (three small stacked box-like shapes, perhaps tiny figures; UNRESOLVED identity) appear on the right limb of Earth at the arrow tip.
Hard cut to dusk landscape: purple-to-pink gradient sky, dark ground line, one grey tombstone centre-left reading 'RIP / CAUSE OF DEATH: TWILIGHT'.
Second tombstone 'RIP / CAUSE OF DEATH: MOONLIGHT' appears to the right of the first; a half-lit white moon with halo appears upper right.

Hard cut to diagram on dark canvas: Earth half lit (left) half dark (right), thick grey atmosphere crescent around it, six white horizontal arrows from the left, label 'TWILIGHT' with tiny white figure at upper right and a tiny figure mark at left edge of the atmosphere; grey gradient glow at left.
White zig-zag scatter lines appear in the atmosphere band around the left of Earth.

Arrows, scatter lines, lit hemisphere and glow removed; Earth now uniformly dark grey with continents; a white beam enters from the left ending in a red glow at the left limb; atmosphere crescent and tiny figure at top remain.
A short glowing red-pink arc with small red arrows around it appears at the impact point hugging the left limb.
Red arc extends further along the limb (upper and lower tips advanced).
Arc extends further; outward arrows start turning grey; upper tip near top of Earth.
Arc extends to wrap around further; atmosphere crescent no longer visible; tiny figure gone.
Arc tips extend further toward the right side.
Arc tips close in further; red spark ends at right; Earth appears slightly smaller/shifted (UNRESOLVED if camera change).
Ring closes into a complete glowing red-pink loop around Earth.
Hard cut to close-up limb: intense white-pink glowing atmosphere band over dark landscape with white beam descending from top.
Debris appears: white sparks at impact, black jagged crust and rock fragments above and along the surface.
Red zig-zag bounce lines with arrowheads appear fanning from the impact outward, bouncing off the debris layer.
Hard cut to dark canvas: white ground line; small white-ink stick figure right of centre; large pink-white glowing wall of light at left with white radial streaks along its edge.
A question mark '?' appears above the figure's head; head appears tilted.
About 25 small white wavy arrows scattered across the dark area appear at once.
Half-lit white moon with red-pink halo appears upper right.
Wavy arrows fade out over 6 frames (full at f2912, dimmer at f2914, gone at f2917); moon and figure remain.
Hard cut to Earth diagram in dark grey: Earth half light half dark showing polar map, grey atmosphere crescent, tiny marks at left and right edges, small moon above, white glow gradient at left.
Earth and moon go dark; white beam from left with red glow appears at the left limb; light gradient removed.
Red glow and many white radiating arrows burst from the impact point; a bright ray runs from the impact up to the now-lit moon at top.
Fan of red rays from the moon down to the right (far) side of Earth appears.
White glowing arc appears around the left of Earth with red spark clusters at its two tips.
Arc extends slightly further.
Arc extends further toward the right.
Arc closes into a full glowing ring around the dark Earth.
Hard cut to dusk scene: two tombstones now broken, text partly legible 'TWILIG...' and 'MOON...IGHT'; flying debris and rocks, pink-white glare from left, moon with chunk upper right.

Hard cut to bright white canvas: stick figure left pointing up; whiteboard with sun-in-ring and nozzle left, red arrow to right, globe upper right with dashed line below it. Back to whiteboard frame (callback to opening).
Red mark cluster appears between sun ring and globe: small up arrow, '?', curved arrow.
Hard cut to dark space: sun inside grey ring at left with beam toward right edge; globe lower right with curved motion lines beneath it.
Globe has jumped up into the beam path; red glow at impact, globe reddening, trails below it.
Globe is now higher than the beam, fully red-tinted with red trails; beam passes below it.
Hard cut to dark starfield: only the red globe, left edge crumbling into particles; sun and beam gone.

Grey tombstone fades in and scales up behind the globe: text 'WE SHOULDN'T HAVE TURNED THE SUN INTO A LASER' on the stone and 'RIP' faintly over the globe; stone gets larger and brighter across f3750-f3755.

Hard cut to red end card: dinosaur-on-satellite black silhouette left; right-side credit text (readable: 'Randall Munroe', 'Henry Reich', 'Lizah van der Aart', 'Ever Salazar', 'Know Art Studios' - roles small); 'GET THE BOOKS: xkcd.com/books' with four book covers lower middle.
